title: August and the Autopsy
author: Noor Vane
blurb: Mirabel Montrose, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
